description: (Na)₂NaGaBr₆ is alpha Rhenium trioxide-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a NaGaBr₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaGaBr₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Br bond lengths are 2.85 Å. Ga is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form GaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ga-Br bond lengths are 2.55 Å. Br is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Ga atom.
